content: AWS Glue 5.0 docker image (public.ecr.aws/glue/aws-glue-libs:5) needs 7GB+ disk; job.init()/GlueContext calls fail locally without mounted AWS credentials (~/.aws) and AWS_PROFILE due to security-configuration and DefaultAWSCredentialsProviderChain lookups; job bookmarks require transformation_ctx and a real Glue job-run continuation state that doesn't exist locally.
